newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonia close border to illegal Albanians.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia close border to illegal Albanians.

text.p: Macedonia has sealed its western border with Albania to halt a wave of illegal immigration by Albanians fleeing unrest and food shortages, media reports said on Thursday.
Two Macedonian soldiers in a border patrol were wounded and an Albanian immigrant killed in a shooting incident on Tuesday.
The Interior Ministry said groups of immigrants were being escorted across the Sara mountains into Macedonia by armed guides to seek work in Macedonia and Greece.
Some 170 Albanians were intercepted by Macedonian authorities on Wednesday and around 500 were thought to have entered the country over the past few days.
